title: Fonts
summary: Wide, quiet lettering for light drawn on the dark: an extended sans in tracked capitals for titles, a light monospace for small UI text, and thin geometric alternates. All bundled locally with open licences.
usage: The theme sets titles in Michroma (tracked capitals, letter-spacing .3em or more) and small labels, readouts and notes in IBM Plex Mono Light. Syncopate and Lexend Zetta are wider alternates for one-word titles; Jura, Exo 2 and Oxanium are thinner geometric alternates; Space Mono, Share Tech Mono and Major Mono Display are alternate monos. Kit names: F.head = Michroma, F.mono = IBM Plex Mono.

items.note: Theme heading face. A wide extended sans: set in capitals, widely tracked, landing orange, burning red and cooling to white.
Theme UI face (weight 300): small readouts, notes, prompts and captions under the light.
Medium weight of the UI face, for small text that must read over bright footage.
Even wider caps-only alternate for one- or two-word titles.
Very widely spaced variable sans; at weight 200 it reads like a thin line of light.
Thin rounded geometric alternate for subtitles and kickers.
Light geometric sans for longer captions.
Squared technical alternate for numbers and readouts.
Heavier mono for counters that must read over busy footage.
Thin mono display face for single labels.
Light modern sans for sentence-case captions.
Geometric sans with a thin weight for quiet subtitles.
